name: koya_gooface
desc: Keep the same melted, dripping paint body, size and pose. The head is pushing out of the goo: the dog face with the long bangs over one eye and a sly smirk, the mouth slightly open with the tongue peeking out and thick paint dripping from it, the pointed ears and spiky hair half formed, still half melted, with thick sticky paint stretching and stringing from the face, the chin and the mouth, gooey and gross. The legs stay a thick melted mass merged into the puddle. Same colors, cream swirls, outline and pixel art style.
